record.paper_title: Billiard Dynamics: A Survey with the Emphasis on Open Problems
record.original_question: Assume that for a dispersive billiard table Y the limit h = lim_{n→∞} (log f_Y(n))/n exists, where f_Y(n) counts periodic orbits of period at most n. Is this growth-rate constant h equal to the topological entropy of the billiard map?

evidence.quote: Problem 6. If the limit in equation (2.2) does exist, is h the topological entropy of the billiard map?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $Y$ be a dispersing (Sinai) billiard table: a compact domain in the plane (or on the 2-torus) whose boundary consists of finitely many smooth strictly convex (looking from inside) arcs, possibly meeting at corners. Consider the associated billiard map $T_Y$ acting on the unit tangent bundle restricted to the boundary, with the standard reflection law (angle of incidence equals angle of reflection). For each integer $n \geq 1$, let $f_Y(n)$ denote the number of periodic orbits of $T_Y$ of period at most $n$. Assume that the limit
$$h \;=\; \lim_{n\to\infty} \frac{\log f_Y(n)}{n}$$
exists. Question: is $h$ necessarily equal to the topological entropy $h_{\mathrm{top}}(T_Y)$ of the billiard map?
artifact.status_search_result: Available literature on dispersing/semi-dispersing billiards establishes upper and lower exponential bounds on periodic-orbit counts and finiteness of topological entropy, but does not assert equality between the periodic-orbit exponential growth rate and the topological entropy in this generality. The question is posed as an open problem in surveys of billiard dynamics, and no published resolution was located.

status_evidence.title: Topological Entropy and Pressure for Finite Horizon Sinai Billiards
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses topological entropy and equilibrium states for Sinai billiards, indicating ongoing research on the relationship between entropy and orbit counts.
status_evidence.claim: Topological entropy of dispersing billiards is an active area; equality with periodic-orbit growth rate is not asserted in general.

status_evidence.title: Topological entropy of semi-dispersing billiards
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes finiteness and bounds for topological entropy of semi-dispersing billiards.
status_evidence.claim: Bounds on entropy and periodic orbits exist but the variational equality is not established.

status_evidence.title: An estimate from above of the number of periodic orbits for semi-dispersed billiards
status_evidence.snippet: Provides exponential upper bounds on the number of periodic orbits for semi-dispersing billiards.
status_evidence.claim: Only one-sided exponential estimates are known.
